raw_result: {"facts": [{"item_id": "3d76aba7195249898c1927c04619ab5c::verbatim_text", "attribute": "verbatim_text", "fact_text": "Red-teaming is another risk measurement and management approach."}, {"item_id": "251a6f90954d4d90b45e631d9c110d5d::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Feedback is collected from stakeholders and users."}, {"item_id": "251a6f90954d4d90b45e631d9c110d5d::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Organizations are to consider and address that feedback across the whole population of intended users."}, {"item_id": "8c26d0d728824aef8dd60e5584eac803::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Documentation provides sufficient information to assist relevant AI actors when making informed decisions and taking subsequent actions."}, {"item_id": "91b7e76065204d719ad644a8354760d2::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "Performance inconsistent with intended use does not always increase risk or lead to negative impacts."}, {"item_id": "c2cedf0bd545401494c30ed72be4c973::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "The people whose experience, expertise, abilities and backgrounds constitute the team that maps context."}, {"item_id": "744a5721377b49bb9df5b5be26d2b891::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Did your organization implement a risk management system"}, {"item_id": "b9d6a1f7a45f4971b621d99be63a9472::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "regular system monitoring is carried out in accordance with"}, {"item_id": "e60e5f9e519c4417a14222c6d544405f::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Statistics such as out-of-range performance, incident response times, system down time, and injuries."}, {"item_id": "e60e5f9e519c4417a14222c6d544405f::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "These statistics are collected in anticipation of information sharing or oversight requirements."}]}
